about: The crowbar as the skeleton holds it, first and third person (player actions S2 round 3, docs/dev/player_actions_v1_plan.md 12). Points, bounds: item block units of the crowbar mesh as client/AflStaticMeshItemClient draws it (meshes/crowbar.aflmesh.json + (0.5, -0.36419, 0.5); y up the bar, the claw curling to -x at the top). Scale 0.53: about 0.91 m long, a 36 inch wrecking bar. Held two-handed, left hand low (the user, 2026-10-16: the left at the end and the right above it is the natural grip): the left at grip_end (the straight end), the right at grip_high, 0.3 block up the bar; swinging, the right slides down to grip, just above the left.
